sections.title: Gästelisten
sections.notes: Row → /guestlists/<id>. Without filter only upcoming-event and permanent lists; no pagination, no search.

uxNotes: Not reachable from the sidebar or ⌘K page list (not in nav.ts) – effectively an orphan overview.
Past events' lists disappear from the default view with no 'Vergangen' segment to find them again (only via the event filter for events up to 2 days back).
No <EmptyState>, no search, no trash view (lists are soft-deleted).

SaveBar label reuses 'Neue Gästeliste' instead of an '… anlegen' verb like other create pages.
Flat form without FormCards; validation errors are a generic 'invalid input' without naming the field.
Artist picker is a NativeSelect of up to 500 rows (guide: pickers search on the server).

actions.label: Liste in den Papierkorb
actions.notes: inside a red 'Gefahrenzone' box (admin.dangerZone); voids all entries' tickets

pages.phone: Entries table becomes cards; each card carries an inline rename form and a remove button.
uxNotes: Trashing a list (which voids every guest ticket) has no confirm and sits in a 'Gefahrenzone' box – the guide forbids danger-zone boxes and asks for a ⋯ destructive item.
'Neuen Link erzeugen' invalidates the shared link without confirmation.
Removing a guest (voids their ticket) has no confirm; icon-only button without tooltip.
Every row is an always-on rename form with its own Speichern button.
Public link can only be opened, not copied (no CopyButton, unlike /members/settings portal link).
Crumbs differ by list type: event lists → Events › event, permanent lists → Gästelisten; after trashing, every list lands on /guestlists (not back on the event).
Header 'Einstellungen' is an outline button with a pencil icon, not the gear `settings` slot.
